description: TPG Coverage Map is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Spatial Services (DCS). Export DataAccess APIMetadata Portal Metadata InformationContent TitleTPG Coverage MapContent TypeOtherDescriptionThis dataset provides data on mobile sires and coverage maps within Australia and is sourced from information collected under the ACCC's Audit of Telecommunications Infrastructure Assets - Record Keeping Rules (Infrastructure RKR). Coverage: Spatial Services (DCS). The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Spatial Services (DCS). Its tags are TPG, coveragemap, live-nsw. It offers 1 resource(s) in ARCGIS REST SERVICE. The portal shows 2025-11-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
